description: Setup and resources for self-hosting your Snikket service!

summary.one_liner: Helper scripts and templates for setting up and managing a self-hosted Snikket chat/messaging service using Docker Compose.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides shell scripts and templates as an alternative to the official Snikket setup guide. An init script performs automatic configuration, a start script launches the service, and a new-invite script creates invitation links for accounts, including admin accounts in a group. The README says the setup begins with the DNS and Docker steps from the Snikket Quickstart, and the scripts are run as root. After startup, the login page is expected to load over HTTP and redirect to HTTPS once certificates are available. Accounts are created through the invitation link, and the chosen address and password can also log into the web administration page.
use_cases: Set up a chat service on my own domain
Create invitation links for new Snikket users
Create an admin account for a Snikket service
Manage a Docker Compose based Snikket deployment
notable: Automated configuration through a single init script instead of the manual quickstart step
Invitation-based account creation, with an admin invite option
Admin invitation can display a QR code for scanning from a mobile device
Requires Docker Compose V2; the legacy docker-compose V1 command is not supported
caveats: Requires Docker Compose V2; will not work with the V1 docker-compose command
Setup must be run as root and assumes completion of the DNS and Docker steps from the Snikket Quickstart
Requires a domain with DNS configured so HTTPS certificates can be issued
